verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a feature-flag platform, so the story applies. The pack shows no in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The only AI-related evidence is an official MCP server that lets external LLM coding assistants manage flags. That is an adjacent integration for a different story, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
